name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Asteroid Mining Operations
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Asteroid Mining Operations
description: A space-based mining program that captures near-Earth asteroids and processes them in orbit for mineral resources, using the space elevator to transport refined materials to the surface. Zheng-Dao's asteroid mining operations target metallic asteroids containing platinum group metals, rare earth elements, and iron-nickel alloys in quantities that dwarf terrestrial reserves. A single captured asteroid can contain more platinum than has been mined in all of human history, and the operational costs are justified by the extraordinary concentration of valuable materials.
enables: Practically unlimited mineral supply from space
Platinum group metals in orbital quantities
social_impact: Asteroid mining has the potential to make every terrestrial mineral resource irrelevant — a single successful capture operation delivers more material than decades of conventional mining. This potential has created both extraordinary corporate value for Zheng-Dao and existential anxiety for the terrestrial mining industry, including Dredge Mining Collective. The first successful large-scale asteroid mineral delivery will crash commodity prices globally and reshape the economics of material production.
story_hooks: Zheng-Dao's first major asteroid capture is approaching processing completion — the asteroid contains an estimated 500 years' worth of global platinum supply, and its arrival on the surface will destroy the platinum market overnight.

An asteroid capture operation has gone wrong — the captured asteroid is in a degrading orbit and Zheng-Dao is scrambling to determine whether it will be processed in time or become an extinction-level impact threat.
